scopes.checked_claim: Original Sec2.1-2.3 and Sec3-6 locate weighted galaxy/random estimators, fixed flat-LCDM coordinate/template values, area-weighted caps, nonlinear bias/TNS/effective bispectrum kernels, AP Eqs9-17, approximate window Eqs18-20 and2048-mock auto/cross covariance. Sec8.1, Table3 third column and Eqs23,25,27 specify one CMASS pre-reconstruction full-AP fit at zeff0.57,kmax0.22 h Mpc^-1. The source reports a conditioned f*sigma8/amplitude-geometry summary with model-error inflation; Table5 combines distinct overlapping RSD/BAO fits. Accepted source reporting is limited by the original printed normalization/label/boundary caveats.
scopes.unresolved: Actual estimator/window/mask/covariance/likelihood/prior/calibration assets and amplitude/species/full-k compatibility are not qualified. Eq28 covariance/exponent and Eq14 orientation conventions remain unresolved; reader corrections are separate. Joint likelihood use requires known dependence/covariance. No executable request, independent amplitude measurement or source-result reproduction is accepted.

limitations: One conditioned CMASS pre-reconstruction full-AP P0+P2+B0 fit: nominal kmin0.02/0.04/0.03 and kmax0.22 h Mpc^-1. Table3 no-AP, Table4 separately reported f/sigma8 at0.17 and Table5 combined RSD/BAO products are distinct.

Actual catalogues, randoms, masks/veto/radial weights, bins/triangle ownership, power multipole estimator, W2/W3 functions, full covariance arrays, inverse correction, nonlinear calibration, likelihood code/chains and prior bounds remain unacquired or unchecked. Their absence is not inferred.

Source Eq28 omits1/2 despite covariance terminology; Eq14 bispectrum orientation normalization is unresolved. The source k/q labels conflict, and its AP-only triangle-loss claim fails for one positive common linear LOS map. Original expressions remain literal; proposed reader repairs are not applied or paper-equivalent.
Printed512^3/box-side cell resolution, bispectrum lower-bound wording and Table3 statistical-error caption have source inconsistencies. Exact author implementation and discrete inclusion are open.

f*sigma8 is a fitted summary conditioned on fiducial geometry, fixed spectral shape, nonlinear bias/RSD/window/mocks and model-error inflation. Exact ordinary sigma8 top-hat/full-k/gauge/matter-species convention is not located in checked passages; a reduced-sector finite-band variance cannot be relabelled sigma8.

RSD P is contained in RSD P+B; Table5 adds post-reconstruction BAO from the same galaxies and shared mock/geometry ancestry. Published within-paper8x8 covariance is referenced in AppendixC but unread here; external cross-analysis covariance remains unknown, never zero.

Targeted source claims only; zero new full/Luna readings, paper-stage or graph promotions. No observed likelihood, estimator implementation, independent numerical reproduction or scientific qualification is accepted.
